description: Defines a recursive data storage class 'Value' for storing settings and persistable data compatible with JSON/JavaScript, including related classes DictionaryValue and ListValue, with methods for manipulation, serialization, and comparison.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: A variant-like class for storing JSON-compatible data types, supporting nested dictionaries and lists, with methods for data access, modification, serialization, and comparison.

classes.name: DictionaryValue
classes.description: A key-value dictionary class derived from Value, supporting nested structures and path-based access.

classes.name: ListValue
classes.description: A list class derived from Value, representing an ordered collection of Values.

methods.name: CreateWithCopiedBuffer
methods.description: Factory method to create a binary Value by copying a buffer (deprecated).

methods.name: FromUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a unique_ptr<Value> to a Value.

methods.name: ToUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a Value to a unique_ptr<Value>.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Value.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a Value::Type.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the stored data.

methods.name: is_none
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type NONE.

methods.name: is_bool
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type BOOLEAN.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type INTEGER.

methods.name: is_string
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type STRING.

methods.name: is_blob
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type BINARY.

methods.name: is_dict
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type DICTIONARY.

methods.name: is_list
methods.description: Checks if the Value is of type LIST.

methods.name: GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean value, asserts type.

methods.name: GetInt
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value, asserts type.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves the string value, asserts type.

methods.name: GetBlob
methods.description: Retrieves the binary data, asserts type.

methods.name: FindKey
methods.description: Finds a value by key in a dictionary.

methods.name: FindKeyOfType
methods.description: Finds a value by key with specific type in a dictionary.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in a dictionary.

methods.name: RemoveKey
methods.description: Removes a key from a dictionary.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Finds a nested value by path.

methods.name: SetPath
methods.description: Sets a nested value by path, creating intermediate dictionaries.

methods.name: RemovePath
methods.description: Removes a nested value by path.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the entire Value tree.

methods.name: MergeDictionary
methods.description: Recursively merges another dictionary into this one.
